mentions.name: grpc-comparator
mentions.description: A proxy that sits between an original service and its replacement, calculating timing and any deltas in responses for the response attributes the user configures it to care about.
mentions.source_excerpt: grpc-comparator proxies between an original service, and it's replacement calculating timing and any deltas in responses. You instruct it which response attributes you care about.
